focus: Hajar Mountains geology in Ras Al Khaimah and Fujairah (Semail ophiolite in the UAE, Wadi gorges, Musandam carbonates, Jebel Jais sections, exotic limestones, mantle sections at Masafi/Khor Fakkan), Hatta (Dubai) geology, coastal sabkhas and lagoons of Ajman and Umm Al Quwain, plus documented archaeological sites in Ajman (e.g. Mowaihat) and Umm Al Quwain (e.g. Akab, Ed-Dur is already mapped).
